notablePrerequisites: You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
description:
Activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Cast Great Whale by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Great Whale enters the battlefield, untapping the seven lands.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Great Whale from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
